title: Single-Agreement Rule for Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements
content:
**Clause.** A customer may hold only one service agreement at a time, covering all of its properties on one covered-property list; a portfolio that outgrows its tier moves to a higher tier on renewal rather than adding a second agreement.

This clause governs enrollment in the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements.

## The clause in its parts

| Element | Content of the clause |
|---|---|
| Agreements one customer may hold at a time | 1 |
| Properties covered | all of the customer's properties, on one covered-property list |
| A portfolio that outgrows its tier | moves to a higher tier on renewal |
| A second agreement | not added |

## Points of application (hypothetical customers)

- A hypothetical property manager that already holds a Silver Priority Service Agreement and acquires further buildings keeps every property on the one covered-property list of that agreement; the clause gives it no second agreement for the new buildings.
- A hypothetical commercial owner whose portfolio has grown past what its current tier may cover moves to a higher tier on renewal; the growth is not met by adding a second agreement beside the first.
- A customer holds at most one agreement at a time whatever the tier, the Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement included.
